verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an AI video-generation tool, so translating a finished video into other languages is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no translation or dubbing of a finished video and no carry-over of voice or lip sync. The only related items are narration TTS keys (Yating Mandarin voices, optional ElevenLabs) and a three-language UI switch. Both are adjacent features and do not count as the capability.
